paper_role: end-to-end architecture and system performance gate
question: Holding the real-prompt A12 predictor and all model/scheduler inputs fixed, does resident request state reduce end-to-end latency and host-device traffic relative to the current host-materializing dataflow without changing the final latent or decoded tensor?

frozen_system.scheduler: FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler with the model's dynamic shift
frozen_system.predictor: order-1 index TaylorSeer over the two most recent real anchors, FP32 linear combination rounded once to BF16
frozen_system.output: raw decoded VAE tensor; packed final latent retained for parity

arms.materializing_A12: Text encode and rotary setup once. At each of 12 anchors, copy host latent and all host context tensors to every TP rank, read rank-0 backbone noise to host, store two host anchors, run the same predictor and FlowMatch Euler update on host, then decode the host final latent.
arms.resident_A12: Text encode and rotary setup once. Stage immutable context into one request-owned device slot, initialize aliased latent once, exchange ranked handles across the same backbone and exact split cache-step runtime for all 50 steps, read only the final latent, then decode it through the same VAE.

prompts: a red fox sitting in a snowy forest at dawn, sharp detail
a bustling night market with neon signs and steam, cinematic
a precise architectural cutaway of a compact coastal research station, labeled rooms, realistic materials
a macro photograph of a translucent blue dragonfly wing covered in morning dew, shallow depth of field
paired_latency_design.warmup: one untimed complete request per arm before measurement
paired_latency_design.order: Within each prompt, alternate AB and BA so each arm runs first three times and second three times.
paired_latency_design.synchronization: Each arm ends only after the raw decoded tensor is materialized on host; stage timers also record encode/setup, context staging, denoise, final read, and decode separately.
paired_latency_design.statistics: Report per-arm P50/P95, paired speedup distributions, paired geometric mean, and deterministic 10,000-resample prompt-stratified bootstrap 95% confidence intervals.

profile_design.requests: one separate materializing request and one separate resident request, same frozen prompt and seed 101, captured in independent neuron-profile inspect sessions
profile_design.accounting_window: denoise only; text encoders and VAE are reported separately and excluded from the resident data-plane boundary count
profile_design.materializing_expectation: 12 repeated context/latent host writes and 12 noise reads
profile_design.resident_expectation: one context staging, one latent initialization, scalar timestep/coefficient/delta control, zero latent/noise host materialization between initialize and finalize, and one final latent read

gates.E1_correctness: All 24 pairs must have final packed latent max-abs=0 and relative-L2=0; all raw decoded tensor pairs must also have max-abs=0 and relative-L2=0.
gates.E2_data_plane_boundary: The profiled resident denoise interval must have zero 524288-byte latent/noise host writes and reads after initialize and before finalize, and no encoder/pooled/rotary writes after staging. Its counted transfer sequence must match the frozen scalar-control design.
gates.E3_paired_significance: The prompt-stratified bootstrap 95% lower confidence bound must exceed 1.0 for both denoise-only and full-request paired geometric-mean speedup.
gates.E4_materiality: Median paired denoise speedup must be at least 1.03x and median paired full-request speedup at least 1.01x.
gates.E5_tail: Resident full-request P95 must be no more than 2% slower than materializing full-request P95 (baseline_P95/resident_P95 >= 0.98).
gates.E6_resource_accounting: Report HBM, compiled artifacts, loads, entry-point counts, and request-slot capacity. Do not extrapolate the two-slot proof to unbounded serving concurrency.

scope_limit: This isolates an architecture change under the same static A12 algorithm. It does not re-qualify A12 against a 50-anchor quality baseline, establish multi-tenant throughput/fairness, or validate adaptive Gram control.

decision.if_all_gates_pass: Use the resident dataflow as the paper's single-request end-to-end system result, then proceed to TP placement and serving slot-pool experiments.
decision.if_traffic_passes_but_latency_fails: Retain the boundary mechanism as engineering evidence but reject latency/speedup as a paper contribution; diagnose dispatch, staging cold-start, and VAE/text dilution before expanding the architecture.
decision.if_correctness_fails: Stop performance interpretation and locate the first divergent step; do not relax the exact fixed-algorithm contract.
decision.if_tail_fails: Treat slot staging or extra cache dispatches as a tail-latency regression and do not claim a serving-ready improvement.
